title: Implement aligned bit circuits for the rank-seven ADD layer
body:
## Summary

PR3076 leaves its native-bound saving untested against concrete coefficient recipes. This adds only `research/rank7-aligned-bit-adders/`: an explicit reversible Boolean ADD layer, an all-width proof and a pinned comparison with PR3060/3076 and PR3078's recipes.

```text
64-bit forward ADD layer, both real components
PR3060 binary control     16,362,450 logical Boolean gates
PR3076 signed lowering    16,313,490
Saving                       48,960 per word/orientation

PR3078 digit-walk recipes     83,430 -> 83,394 unit instructions
```

Both providers and orientations agree. The Boolean saving is exactly `384W-144` Toffolis plus `384W-48` CNOTs for `5 <= W <= 256`. The source stays read-only and all W-1 clean carries return. Both bit policies are constructed here; the binary baseline is a control, not an existing or optimal physical backend.

[Proof, exact sources, deterministic evidence and reproduction](https://github.com/petalas/integer-mult-bounds/tree/fd5ff58c6c438c438481bc4bff8c86e2d4fbe865/research/rank7-aligned-bit-adders). [Canonical finding/claim](https://github.com/CrocSwap/integer-mult-bounds/discussions/2612#discussioncomment-18983912).

## Evidence

- **Before:** PR3076 reports a conservative bound reduction of 340, without a materialized recipe or bit-gate comparison. **After:** exact certified recipes save 36 units; serialized bit templates and complete native coefficient histograms establish the separate Boolean tariff above. Every non-ADD native event and recursive child remains unchanged.
- Four fresh native transport/emitter pairs cover both providers and orientations, all 632 live columns and the private endpoints. There are 311,016 exhaustive aligned cases across small-width templates, eleven behavioral groups, semantic/source/carry/format rejection controls and a separate scalar-bit interpreter.
- Registered Python 3.12 replay, optimized replay, byte-identical Python 3.14 evidence, strict Ruff checks, source compilation and all 33 committed-publication-byte comparisons pass. Two internal read-only reviews independently reconstruct the arithmetic and tariffs. Canonical main remains `d8e0f83f`, priority revision 6; live overlap was refreshed before submission.

```sh
TMPDIR="$RUN/tmp" uv run --python 3.12 --no-project python -B \
  scripts/research_package.py --package research/rank7-aligned-bit-adders
```

`RUN` is an external session-owned directory with an existing `tmp` subdirectory. Credit PR3076/3078, PR3060/3056, dcharb78/PR3042, Jeremy Kothe/PR3015, Marius-Paul Dumitrean/PR2979, Cinna Davis, icekylinx, Tekalign and the retained native/owner lineage. Development used substantial automated assistance; no independent human or formal-kernel review is claimed.

## Merge Danger

**Door:** two-way.

**Blast Radius:** isolated.

The actual caller must still supply permanent source alignment and signed endpoint capacity. Intermediate sums are modular. Clean-carry backing, routing and non-ADD physical execution remain additional. The complete physical caller, supplier/outer release and all-size obligations are not established. Recursive profile and kappa are unchanged; the selected frontier and frozen predecessors are untouched.
